plan-3.title: A space, then a way to measure
plan-3.body: The same coordinate description can admit different length rules. Riemann will examine a particular quadratic class, rather than assuming the full modern definition of a smooth manifold and metric at the outset. His “space” here is physical space: experience informs which measurement assumptions apply to it.

projection-residual.body: For the coordinate plane \(z=0\), projection and reflection have particularly simple matrices:\[P=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&0\end{pmatrix},\]\[R=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&-1\end{pmatrix}.\]
